checks.check: the standalone page lists 22 billboards and 3 ground panels with prices and availability
booking requires a signed-in game account
a shortened destination link is refused before checkout
text on gold controls meets WCAG AA contrast
checkout starts with the provider (simulated Paystack page)
the payer returns to the advertising page and sees verified payment status
the campaign is live immediately, with no manual approval
the placement serves the new campaign to the world (dansoman)
a player already in the game is told to refresh that board (no reload)
fulfilment came from a signed webhook verified server-to-server, recorded in PostgreSQL
a campaign the checks cannot clear waits in a disclosed review, with the reason shown
a cancelled checkout returns as not paid; nothing activates
the phone app is a shortcut to the standalone page

scope: Loopback QA server with PAYSTACK_MOCK=1 (simulated provider, signed webhook, server verification); disposable accounts; no real money.
